reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the change intended to prevent rapid re-registration after failed connectivity pings. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #178 by preventing repeated registration requests when connectivity pings fail while the platform’s version endpoint remains available. **Changes:** - Waits for the next `ping_alive_schedule` tick before retrying registration after a failed ping. - Adds a regression test using a stand-in API to check that failed pings do not trigger rapid re-registration. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​engine/​mod.rs` | Adds the failed-ping wait and a regression test for registration frequency. |
Review effort: Balanced
